question: What was the name of the operation that led to the annexation of the Hyderabad State into India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Operation Polo.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Operation Polo** was the covert name for the Dominion of India's** "police action"** against** Hyderabad state in September 1948.**
 
• The** Indian armed forces** assaulted and annexed the** Nizam-ruled princely **kingdom in this military campaign.
 
• Because of the state's position, Sardar Patel had serious doubts about the **Nizam of Hyderabad's intentions**. 
 
• Hyderabad state was in the heart of India, surrounded by land. In defiance of the **'Standstill Agreement,'** Hyderabad committed to giving** Pakistan Rs 20 crore**.
 
• Pakistan intended to utilize the funds to purchase **weapons and ammunition **in preparation for a conflict with India over Kashmir.
 
• The Nizam of Hyderabad, in a sense, was subsidizing **Pakistan's war against India.**
 
• On the orders of Home Minister Sardar Patel, forces invaded Hyderabad on September 13, 1948, and finished the operation on September 17, 1948.
 
• Because **Hyderabad** had the **most polo grounds** in the world at the time, the Indian Army's campaign was named **Operation Polo.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Operation Sunrise**__

 
 
• The **Indian Army **launched ‘Operation Sunrise’, the** biggest-ever operation against insurgents** holed up across the border in** Myanmar **with excellent cooperation with the **Myanmarese Tatmadaw.**
 
• It was an astute strategic geo-positioning as both** Myanmar and India** worked in tandem to send a message to China and in the process crushed a long list of insurgent groups starting from the** Arakan Army to NSCN (K) **across the **1,640-km-long **boundary that the two countries share.
